blocks.text: Kamyab karobar gahakon ki zarooratein samajhte hain. Karachi mein water purifier bechne wala garm garmiyon mein saaf peene ke pani par zor de sakta hai. Lahore ka start-up jo online haath ki bani zevrat bechta hai Instagram aur Facebook par products dikhata, maqami influencers ke saath kaam karta aur shadi ke mausam mein mehdood waqt ki riyayat de kar sales barhata hai. Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke Pakistan mein e-commerce tezi se barh raha hai, to online achhi marketing karne wale karobar kahin zyada sameen tak pohanchte hain.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: apni pasand ke product ki marketing aur sales hikmat-e-amli banayein. Is ke zaroori ajza kya hain, aur mukhtalif markets ke liye kaise dhalenge (long question 5)?
blocks.explanation: Ajza: target market aur us ki zarooratein, wazeh brand aur paigham, gahakon tak raaste, qeemat, riyayat aur promotions jaisi tadabeer, gahak ki khidmat, aur nataij naapne ka tareeqa. Dhalna: jawan shehri khareedar Instagram aur influencers aur online riyayat se; dehi ya umar raseeda khareedar maqami dukanon, radio ya zabani tashheer se; Eid aur shadiyon jaise mausam khaas offers mangte hain.

items: Gahakon ki zarooratein jaan kar durust raaston aur offers se poori karein (online zevrat start-up).
